title: peatland-rewetting-utac - P131: Peatland rewetting CO2 sink, methane, biodiversity honesty
description: Peatland rewetting science: Guenther et al. 2020 (DOI 10.1038/s41467-020-15499-z; 2024 Author Correction DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-47604-x -- N2O-to-CO2 factor 14 vs 28 bug fixed, correction already applied) temperate drained/rewetted fluxes; Nationale Moorschutzstrategie DE 2022 (at least 5 Mt CO2e/yr by 2030, ~53 Mt, ~7.5%); Kreyling et al. 2021 (DOI 10.1038/s41467-021-25619-y) fen biodiversity honesty -- no full restoration, no convergence over three decades. Unverified ~20 t CO2e/ha/yr figure intentionally omitted. Deliberately no UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge -- see DISCLAIMER.md. Own package, not a P100/P107 extension. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P131).
